method: Zhang/Cohen/Curless 2018 sections 3-5; local 3D spherical limiter-area votes, discovery, feasible increments, NNLS, LM, leave-one-source-out relocation
relocation_guard: Reject a leave-one-out proposed move if it overpredicts any required observation; do not clip negative residuals into fake measurements
training: Geometry-only split, no withheld RGB or source answers; fixed sample coordinates and input hashes before discovery

linear_box.brdf: known unit diffuse response, explicit common scale

compiled.kernel: conditional diffuse inverse-square response on supplied sanitized geometry; not exact compiler replay
compiled.transfer_hypothesis: Owned gamma=1, no sRGB, unsaturated floor-code intervals; interval midpoints in compiler-relative preencoding domain
compiled.saturated: exclude whole RGB vector before fitting; keep exclusion count

optimization: SciPy 1.16.3 NNLS, then MINPACK Levenberg-Marquardt; logistic bounded XYZ and positive log intensity. Failed joint fits remain provisional; incremental state retains positivity.
paper_differences: Bounded room-local lattice and deterministic peak extraction, numerical optimizer library differs from Ceres, finite work limits, training-normalized 3D tolerance; these are not the authors' exact experimental parameters
publication: Research result only; no production solver, runtime, or canonical storage changes
experiment: Finer increments and two local 3x3x3 vote-peak refinements, same scenes/folds/acceptance thresholds as coarse v1; results reported alongside coarse experiment
